integrity: A self-contained analytic proof and standalone supplementary checker are supplied; coverage searches do not certify priority, and independent verification is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Real finite-dimensional unweighted \(\ell_p\) spaces only for \(1<p<\infty\) and positive \(\ell_1\)-ball radii. General induced centering norms are not given in elementary closed form. Relevant historical centering-matrix norm references may exist outside inspected records.
title: Exponent-invariant cross-polytope projection and its sharp Lipschitz threshold
